mapper.select: SELECT id, name_en, name_zh, avatar_url, intro, background, difficulty_level, official_video_url, move_list_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM characters ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, name_en, name_zh, avatar_url, intro, background, difficulty_level, official_video_url, move_list_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM characters WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO characters (name_en, name_zh, avatar_url, intro, background, difficulty_level, official_video_url, move_list_image_url) VALUES (#{nameEn}, #{nameZh}, #{avatarUrl}, #{intro}, #{background}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{officialVideoUrl}, #{moveListImageUrl})
